title: DATACORE-X: health-aware economic MPC for data-centre cooling - simulation twin, controllers and experiments (v1.0.0)

creators.name: Deshmukh, Anup
creators.affiliation: Vishwakarma Institute of Technology, Pune, India

description: MATLAB/Simulink simulation twin of an 8-rack air-cooled data hall (cross-verified against a Python surrogate), PI-HA-EMPC supervisory controller using live Health Index and RUL, experiment scripts E1-E6 with seeds and configuration, generated result tables, and the paper's LaTeX sources. All results are from simulation.
notes: Reproduce with run_all.m (see REPRODUCE.md). Weather data are downloaded from the Open-Meteo historical archive (ERA5-based).
